/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.stack_frames[0], (.value|tostring)] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{sum["'$1]+=$2; if($2>0)pos[$1]+=$2; else neg[$1]+=-$2} END {for(k in sum) printf "%d'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%s\\n\",sum[k],pos[k],neg[k],k}' | sort -nr | head -30
jq -r '[.stack_frames[2], .stack_frames[1], (.value|tostring)] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{k="'$1" | "$2; sum[k]+=$3; if($3>0)pos[k]+=$3; else neg[k]+=-$3} END {for(k in sum) printf "%d'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%s\\n\",sum[k],pos[k],neg[k],k}' | sort -nr | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -s 'def side("'$p): map(select(if $p then .value>0 else .value<0 end)); {candidate_ops:(side(true)|map(.value)|add), base_ops:(side(false)|map(-.value)|add), candidate_repeated:(side(true)|map(select(.stack_frames[0]=="result:repeated")|.value)|add), base_repeated:(side(false)|map(select(.stack_frames[0]=="result:repeated")|-.value)|add), candidate_sessions_with_repeated:(side(true)|map(select(.stack_frames[0]=="result:repeated")|.labels.source_session[0])|unique|length), base_sessions_with_repeated:(side(false)|map(select(.stack_frames[0]=="result:repeated")|.labels.source_session[0])|unique|length), candidate_sessions:(side(true)|map(.labels.source_session[0])|unique|length), base_sessions:(side(false)|map(.labels.source_session[0])|unique|length)}'"' samples.jsonl
jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\") | [.stack_frames[2], (.value|tostring)] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{sum["'$1]+=$2; if($2>0)pos[$1]+=$2;else neg[$1]+=-$2} END{for(k in sum) printf "%d'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%s\\n\",sum[k],pos[k],neg[k],k}' | sort -nr | head -15"
